newRepos.description: 关掉国产安卓手机系统里的广告、热搜、资讯推荐和营销推送。不 root，可还原，支持 AI 智能体一键执行。

newRepos.description: The agent skills I use every day. Works with Claude Code and Codex.

newRepos.description: Steering-first neuron explorer for Qwen3.5-4B: push every MLP neuron, keep every rollout, browse the results

newRepos.summaryZh: php2shell 两个 CVE 的 PoC 利用脚本，演示在存在漏洞的 PHP 环境中实现远程代码执行。仅用于安全研究和教育目的，适合安全学习者在授权靶场中理解漏洞原理与利用过程。

newRepos.description: High fidelity scanner for php2shell (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619)

gems.description: An easier way to use AI on your own computer. A free, open-source alternative to Claude and ChatGPT that runs open-weight models like Gemma and gpt-oss locally on Mac, Windows and Linux. Private, and works offline.
gems.summaryZh: Hob 是一款免费开源的本地 AI 桌面应用，作为 Claude 和 ChatGPT 的替代品，在 Mac、Windows、Linux 上通过 llama.cpp 运行 Gemma、gpt-oss 等开放权重模型，支持 MCP，数据完全私密且可离线使用。适合注重隐私、希望在自己电脑上使用大模型而不依赖云服务的用户。

gems.description: An easier way to use AI on your own computer. A free, open-source alternative to Claude and ChatGPT that runs open-weight models like Gemma and gpt-oss locally on Mac, Windows and Linux. Private, and works offline.
gems.summaryZh: Hob 是一款免费开源的本地 AI 桌面应用，作为 Claude 和 ChatGPT 的替代品，在 Mac、Windows、Linux 上通过 llama.cpp 运行 Gemma、gpt-oss 等开放权重模型，支持 MCP，数据完全私密且可离线使用。适合注重隐私、希望在自己电脑上使用大模型而不依赖云服务的用户。

gems.description: fheroes2 is a recreation of Heroes of Might and Magic II game engine

gems.description: Find code by asking what it does. A CLI for coding agents that uses Jev to discover relevant files and source context.

gems.reasonZh: 到处扫泄漏的密钥和凭证，CI 和本地都能接，Go 写的单二进制好部署。相对 gitleaks 这类老牌工具，它在动态分析和多来源扫描上更全，适合团队把密钥检查塞进流水线。

gems.description: Customize Claude Code's system prompts, create custom toolsets, input pattern highlighters, themes/thinking verbs/spinners, customize input box & user message styling, support AGENTS.md, unlock private/unreleased features, and much more.  Supports both native/npm installs on all platforms.
